# Live audio preset

The live audio preset — a player, feature bundle, skins, and media for live audio streams

`@videojs/react/live-audio` is the preset for live audio streams. It bundles `LiveAudioPlayer`, the `liveAudioFeatures` bundle it is configured with, four skins that swap the time slider and time displays for a Live button, and the `Audio` media component. See [Presets](../../guides/presets.md) for how presets fit together and [Live streams](../../guides/live-streams.md) for playing a live source.

## Import

```tsx
import { Audio, LiveAudioPlayer, LiveAudioSkin } from '@videojs/react/live-audio';
import '@videojs/react/live-audio/skin.css';
```

Each skin has its own stylesheet. Import `@videojs/react/live-audio/neutral-skin.css`, `compat-skin.css`, or `scaffold-skin.css` instead when you use `NeutralLiveAudioSkin`, `CompatLiveAudioSkin`, or `ScaffoldLiveAudioSkin`.

## Usage

Live streams are usually HLS, so this example plays through an HLS media component instead of the preset’s native audio.

**App.tsx**

```tsx
import { HlsAudio } from '@videojs/react/media/hls-audio';
import { LiveAudioPlayer, LiveAudioSkin } from '@videojs/react/live-audio';
import '@videojs/react/live-audio/skin.css';

export function App() {
  return (
    <LiveAudioPlayer>
      <LiveAudioSkin>
        <HlsAudio src="https://example.com/live.m3u8" />
      </LiveAudioSkin>
    </LiveAudioPlayer>
  );
}
```

## Player

`LiveAudioPlayer` is a [`Player`](../components/player.md) created by [`createPlayer`](./create-player.md) with `liveAudioFeatures`. It provides the player store to its descendants and renders no DOM element of its own.

`LiveAudioPlayerProps` types its props:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | Content placed inside the player context: a skin, the media, and your own components. |
| `title` | `string \| null` | The title to display. Takes precedence over the title the media reports; `null` clears your value, so the title falls back to the one the media reports. |
| `poster` | `string \| null` | The poster to display. Takes precedence over the poster the media reports; `null` clears your value, so the poster falls back to the one the media reports. |

`title` and `poster` come from the [metadata feature](./feature-metadata.md#player-inputs).

The preset also exports a `usePlayer` hook typed to `liveAudioFeatures`. Use it from any component inside `LiveAudioPlayer`; see [`usePlayer`](./use-player.md).

## Feature bundle

`liveAudioFeatures` is the array of [features](../../guides/features.md) the player is configured with. It is the [audio preset’s](./preset-audio.md#feature-bundle) `audioFeatures` without playback rate, plus the [live feature](./feature-live.md):

| Feature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`playbackFeature`](./feature-playback.md) | Play/pause state and actions for the player store |
| [`volumeFeature`](./feature-volume.md) | Volume level and mute state for the player store |
| [`timeFeature`](./feature-time.md) | Playback position and duration state for the player store |
| [`sourceFeature`](./feature-source.md) | Media source state and actions for the player store |
| [`bufferFeature`](./feature-buffer.md) | Buffered and seekable time range state for the player store |
| [`errorFeature`](./feature-error.md) | Media error state and actions for the player store |
| [`liveFeature`](./feature-live.md) | Live edge state for the player store |
| [`metadataFeature`](./feature-metadata.md) | Resolved title and poster values for the player store |

Its type, `LiveAudioFeatures`, is the tuple of those features in order. Import it from the package root:

```tsx
import type { LiveAudioFeatures } from '@videojs/react';
```

To add or remove a feature, pass your own array to `createPlayer`. The skins expect the features they render controls for.

```tsx
import { createPlayer, streamTypeFeature } from '@videojs/react';
import { liveAudioFeatures } from '@videojs/react/live-audio';

const { Player, usePlayer } = createPlayer({
  features: [...liveAudioFeatures, streamTypeFeature],
});
```

## Skins

- [LiveAudioSkin](../components/live-audio-skin.md) — the default skin, which swaps the time controls for a Live button.
- [NeutralLiveAudioSkin](../components/live-audio-neutral-skin.md) — the visually lighter variant, closer to a classic control bar.
- [CompatLiveAudioSkin](../components/live-audio-compat-skin.md) — the plain, unbranded variant that avoids newer visual effects, so it looks consistent across browsers.
- [ScaffoldLiveAudioSkin](../components/live-audio-scaffold-skin.md) — the minimally styled variant of Compat, a foundation for your own design.

See [Choose a skin](../../guides/skins.md#choose-a-skin) to compare them.

## Media

The preset exports [`Audio`](../components/audio.md), the same component as the audio preset, which renders a native `<audio>`. Most browsers need a streaming [media component](../../guides/media-sources.md) to play a live source, such as [`HlsAudio`](../components/hls-audio.md) for HLS.

## Exports

`@videojs/react/live-audio` exports:

| Export | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `LiveAudioPlayer`, `LiveAudioPlayerProps` | The preconfigured [player](#player). |
| `usePlayer` | The player-store hook, typed to `liveAudioFeatures`. |
| `liveAudioFeatures` | The [feature bundle](#feature-bundle). |
| `LiveAudioSkin`, `LiveAudioSkinProps` | The default [skin](#skins). |
| `NeutralLiveAudioSkin`, `NeutralLiveAudioSkinProps` | The neutral [skin](#skins). |
| `CompatLiveAudioSkin`, `CompatLiveAudioSkinProps` | The compat [skin](#skins). |
| `ScaffoldLiveAudioSkin`, `ScaffoldLiveAudioSkinProps` | The scaffold [skin](#skins). |
| `Audio`, `AudioProps` | The [media](#media) component. |

Stylesheets: `@videojs/react/live-audio/skin.css`, `@videojs/react/live-audio/neutral-skin.css`, `@videojs/react/live-audio/compat-skin.css`, and `@videojs/react/live-audio/scaffold-skin.css`.
